questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: A light year is a unit of:
questions.e: A light year is the distance light travels in one year (~9.46 × 10¹² km) — a unit of distance, not time.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: Which mirror always forms an erect and diminished image?
questions.e: A convex mirror always gives a virtual, erect, diminished image — which is why it is used as a rear-view mirror.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: In a series circuit, the ___ is the same through all components.
questions.e: Series means one path: the same current flows everywhere, while voltage divides across components.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: The lens in the human eye is:
questions.e: The eye's crystalline lens is convex (converging); it focuses light onto the retina.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: Water boils at sea level at:
questions.e: At standard atmospheric pressure (sea level), water boils at 100°C and freezes at 0°C.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: When a metal reacts with a dilute acid, the gas released is:
questions.e: Metal + acid → salt + hydrogen gas. Hydrogen burns with a 'pop' — the classic lab test.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: Washing soda is chemically:
questions.e: Washing soda is sodium carbonate, Na₂CO₃. NaHCO₃ is baking soda; NaOH is caustic soda.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: The pH of lemon juice is approximately:
questions.e: Lemon juice contains citric acid with pH around 2 — firmly acidic (below 7).

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: The element with the chemical symbol Fe is:
questions.e: Fe comes from the Latin 'ferrum' = iron. Fluorine is F, lead is Pb, tin is Sn.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: Dry ice is solid:
questions.e: Dry ice is solid CO₂; it sublimes directly to gas without melting.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: The largest organ of the human body is the:
questions.e: The skin is the largest organ by area and weight; the liver is the largest internal organ.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: The universal recipient blood group is:
questions.e: AB positive can receive from all groups (no anti-A/anti-B antibodies). O negative is the universal donor.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: Goitre is caused by the deficiency of:
questions.e: Goitre (enlarged thyroid) is caused by iodine deficiency — which is why salt is iodised.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: The process by which plants lose water vapour from leaves is:
questions.e: Transpiration is water loss from leaves; photosynthesis makes food; respiration releases energy.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: The Revolt of 1857 started at:
questions.e: The revolt began at Meerut on 10 May 1857 before spreading to Delhi, Kanpur and Lucknow.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: Fundamental Rights are contained in:
questions.e: Fundamental Rights are in Part III (Articles 12–35); Part IV holds the Directive Principles.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: Who gave the slogan 'Jai Jawan Jai Kisan'?
questions.e: Lal Bahadur Shastri coined 'Jai Jawan Jai Kisan' during the 1965 war, honouring soldiers and farmers.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: The minimum age required to become the President of India is:
questions.e: Article 58 requires the President to be at least 35 years old (25 is for Lok Sabha MPs).

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: The ancient site of Harappa is located in present-day:
questions.e: Harappa (Punjab province) and Mohenjo-daro (Sindh) both lie in present-day Pakistan.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: The capital of Australia is:
questions.e: Canberra is the capital; Sydney is the largest city — the classic capital-vs-largest-city trap.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: Which is the longest river in the world?
questions.e: The Nile (~6,650 km) is conventionally the longest river; the Amazon is the close rival and the largest by discharge.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: The Thar Desert is located in:
questions.e: The Thar (Great Indian Desert) lies mainly in Rajasthan, extending into Pakistan.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: The 82.5°E meridian (IST) passes near:
questions.e: IST is reckoned from 82.5°E, which passes near Mirzapur in Uttar Pradesh.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: The national bird of India is the:
questions.e: The Indian peacock (Pavo cristatus) is the national bird; the Bengal tiger is the national animal.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: The first man to walk on the Moon was:
questions.e: Neil Armstrong walked on the Moon on 21 July 1969 (Apollo 11). Yuri Gagarin was the first man in space (1961).

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: The currency of the United Kingdom is the:
questions.e: The UK uses the pound sterling (£); it did not adopt the euro.

questions.subject: Mock Paper
questions.q: Milkha Singh was popularly known as the:
questions.e: 'Flying Sikh' was Milkha Singh, the legendary sprinter. 'Haryana Hurricane' is Kapil Dev; 'Payyoli Express' is P. T. Usha.

questions.subject: General
questions.q: SAREX-2026, the 12th National Maritime Search & Rescue Exercise, was conducted off:
questions.e: Held 7–8 October 2026 by the Indian Coast Guard under the theme 'Leveraging Technology to Strengthen SAR Preparedness and Maritime Safety'; the scenario combined a 228-person aircraft ditching with the MV Zumba collision. Reviewed by DG Paramesh Sivamani; 32 observers from 30 countries.

questions.subject: General
questions.q: Exercise KONKAN-26 (October 2026) is the annual bilateral maritime exercise between India and:
questions.e: INS Trishul, a guided-missile stealth frigate, reached Plymouth for the exercise (8–15 October 2026) under the India-UK Vision 2035 partnership.

questions.subject: General
questions.q: DRDO's Project Gandiva, with a planned range above 300 km, is also known as:
questions.e: India's third-generation beyond-visual-range air-to-air missile programme (reported 5 October 2026): Astra Mk-1 (~100 km, in IAF service), Mk-2 (200+ km), Mk-3/Project Gandiva (300+ km).

questions.subject: General
questions.q: At IAF Day 2026 (94th anniversary, 8 October, Hindon), the missile reported on public display for the first time was:
questions.e: The event's theme was 'Indian Air Force – Infallible, Impervious and Precise'; Rafale, Su-30MKI, Jaguar, Tejas, Prachand and Dhruv were also displayed.

questions.subject: Exercises
questions.q: Which edition of Exercise Tarang Shakti concluded in October 2026?
questions.e: Exercise Tarang Shakti 2026, which concluded on 13 October 2026 at Jodhpur Airbase, was the second edition of the IAF’s flagship multilateral drill, with eight nations participating.

questions.subject: Exercises
questions.q: Approximately how many sorties were flown during Exercise Tarang Shakti 2026?
questions.e: During Tarang Shakti 2026, about 150 domestic and foreign fighter aircraft flew 600+ sorties totalling around 800 hours of complex aerial operations.

questions.subject: Exercises
questions.q: Which aircraft made its first-ever flight in Indian airspace during Tarang Shakti 2026?
questions.e: The US fifth-generation stealth fighter F-35 Lightning II flew in Indian airspace for the first time during Tarang Shakti 2026 — the highlight of the exercise.

questions.subject: Appointments
questions.q: Who takes over as Chief of the Air Staff on 1 November 2026?
questions.e: Chief Air Chief Marshal Amarpreet Singh flew a Tejas on his final fighter-pilot sortie at Jodhpur on 13 October 2026 and retires on 31 October. Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit takes over as Chief of the Air Staff on 1 November 2026.

questions.subject: Exercises
questions.q: Mountain Guardian 2026, the India–UAE joint exercise underway in October 2026, is which edition?
questions.e: The 3rd edition of the India–UAE joint exercise Mountain Guardian 2026 runs 5–18 October 2026 at Chaubatia, Uttarakhand, with 92 personnel focusing on sub-conventional mountain operations.

questions.subject: International relations
questions.q: On 13 October 2026, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh held bilateral talks in New Delhi with which Czech leader?
o: Karel Havlicek, First Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Industry and Trade
Petr Pavel, President of the Czech Republic
Petr Fiala, Prime Minister of the Czech Republic
questions.e: Karel Havlicek, First Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Industry and Trade of the Czech Republic, met Rajnath Singh on 13 October 2026 to expand defence industrial cooperation, including joint ventures.

questions.subject: International relations
questions.q: Which body was identified as the key platform for advancing India-Czech defence industrial cooperation in October 2026?
questions.e: The India-Czech Joint Defence Committee will remain the key platform for advancing the partnership, including joint ventures supporting Make in India and Aatmanirbhar Bharat.

questions.subject: DRDO
questions.q: In October 2026, the DRDO flight-tested which high-altitude platform?
questions.e: The DRDO flight-tested a stratospheric airship in October 2026, adding a persistent high-altitude surveillance and communications platform to its aerospace portfolio.

questions.subject: DRDO
questions.q: DRDO will lead a thematic session on 'Semiconductors and Next-Gen Chips' at ESTIC-2026, scheduled for:
questions.e: The Emerging Science, Technology & Innovation Conclave (ESTIC-2026) runs 27-29 October 2026, jointly organised by 12 ministries under the Principal Scientific Adviser; DRDO leads the semiconductors and next-gen chips session.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: ULPGM-V3, successfully test-fired by DRDO in October 2026, stands for:
questions.e: ULPGM = UAV-Launched Precision Guided Missile (also designated ULM-ER), a drone-launched, fire-and-forget air-to-surface missile.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: Where was the ULPGM-V3 missile test-fired?
questions.e: ULPGM-V3 was test-fired at Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh, in the National Open Area Range.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: What is the weight of the ULPGM-V3 missile?
questions.e: ULPGM-V3 weighs 12.5 kg and uses dual-thrust solid propulsion with an imaging infrared seeker.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: The Astra missile is best described as a:
questions.e: Astra is an indigenous Beyond Visual Range Air-to-Air Missile (BVRAAM) with range over 100 km, in service with the IAF.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: VL-SRSAM, developed by DRDO for the Indian Navy, is a:
o: Vertical Launch Short Range Surface-to-Air Missile
questions.e: VL-SRSAM = Vertical Launch Short Range Surface-to-Air Missile, designed to protect warships from low-flying missiles, aircraft and drones.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.q: By when must NDA & NA (II) 2026 written-exam qualifiers complete their SSB registration formalities?
o: Within two weeks of the 9 Oct 2026 result
Within one month of the written exam
questions.e: Qualifiers must register within two weeks of the result announcement (around 23 October 2026).

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.q: Qualified NDA & NA (II) 2026 candidates will join which course commencing 1 July 2027?
questions.e: The 158th NDA Course / 120th INAC commences 1 July 2027 at Khadakwasla (Pune) and Ezhimala (Kerala).

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.q: Which country test-fired the extended-range Fatah-2 hypersonic missile in October 2026?
questions.e: Pakistan successfully test-fired the extended-range Fatah-2 hypersonic missile (Oct 2026).

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.q: Air India flight AI2030 (Frankfurt-Delhi) was diverted to which city after a suspected hijack threat in October 2026?
questions.e: AI2030 was diverted to Jaipur following the security alert.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.q: Who delivered the inaugural address at the ASEAN-India Defence Think Tank Forum in October 2026?
questions.e: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh delivered the inaugural address.

questions.subject: GAT (GK)
questions.q: The supreme command of the Indian Armed Forces is vested in:
questions.e: Under Article 53 of the Constitution, the supreme command of the Defence Forces of the Union vests in the President of India.

questions.subject: GAT (GK)
questions.q: Under the Agnipath scheme, Agniveers are enrolled for a service period of:
questions.e: Under the Agnipath scheme (introduced 2022), recruits (Agniveers) serve for four years, with up to 25% eligible for enrolment as regular cadre thereafter.

questions.subject: GAT (GK)
questions.q: Who was India's first Chief of Defence Staff (CDS)?
questions.e: General Bipin Rawat was appointed India's first Chief of Defence Staff in December 2019; he died in a helicopter crash in December 2021.

questions.subject: GAT (GK)
questions.q: India secured the Siachen Glacier — the world's highest battlefield — through which military operation?
questions.e: The Siachen Glacier, at heights above 20,000 feet, is the world's highest battlefield; India secured it through Operation Meghdoot in April 1984.

questions.subject: GAT (GK)
questions.q: 'Project 75I' of the Indian Navy relates to the acquisition of:
questions.e: The Indian Navy's submarine acquisition programme for six conventional submarines built in India with foreign collaboration is designated Project 75I (Project 75 covered the Scorpene-class Kalvari submarines).

questions.subject: GAT (Science)
questions.q: A vehicle travels at a constant speed of 60 km/h for 2.5 hours. How far does it travel?
questions.e: Distance = speed × time = 60 × 2.5 = 150 km.

questions.subject: DRDO
questions.q: Mission Divyastra was the successful flight trial of an Advanced Agni missile equipped with MIRV technology. From where was it launched?
o: Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Island, Odisha
questions.e: Launched from Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Island, Odisha. Multiple payloads were designed to strike different targets spread over a large geographical area in the Indian Ocean Region; the full flight path was tracked by integrated ground- and ship-based telemetry stations. PM Modi lauded DRDO scientists for the trial.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: The 298-km Nimmu–Padum–Darcha road (dedicated 15 October 2026) strengthens strategic mobility for the armed forces because it:
o: Provides an alternative corridor to Ladakh besides the Srinagar–Leh and Manali–Leh highways
Is India's longest tunnel road project
Connects Leh directly to the Siachen base camp
Is the first border road built entirely by the BRO
questions.e: The road connects Nimmu (Leh) with Darcha (Himachal Pradesh) through the Zanskar Valley, giving Ladakh an alternative corridor and improving military logistics.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: Which Indian Navy ship is participating in IBSAMAR IX, the India–Brazil–South Africa maritime exercise, in October 2026?
questions.e: INS Tarkash is participating in the ninth edition of IBSAMAR in South Africa. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: Mountain Guardian 2026, held at Chaubatia in Uttarakhand and ending on 18 October 2026, is a bilateral exercise between India and which country?
questions.e: Mountain Guardian 2026 is the India–UAE exercise held at Chaubatia, Uttarakhand, ending 18 October 2026. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: Who becomes the Chief of the Air Staff on 31 October 2026?
questions.e: Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit becomes Chief of the Air Staff on 31 October 2026. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: The Indian Army's 10+2 Technical Entry Scheme (TES-57) course commencing in July 2027 notified how many provisional vacancies?
questions.e: TES-57 notified 90 provisional vacancies for unmarried candidates; the last date is 12 November 2026. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: The Cabinet Secretariat's DFO (Technical) recruitment 2026 (Advt No. 02/2026) for 250 Group B posts shortlists candidates on the basis of which score?
questions.e: Shortlisting is on a valid GATE score (2024, 2025 or 2026) in the notified subject, followed by interview; applications are offline, 17 Oct–15 Nov 2026. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

questions.subject: Defence GK
questions.q: The Indian Air Force retained how many Agniveer Vayu personnel from its first batch of 2,850 for absorption into the regular cadre in October 2026?
questions.e: The IAF retained 712 of the 2,850 first-batch Agniveer Vayu personnel — about 25% — for the regular cadre, in line with the Agnipath scheme's provision that up to 25% of each batch may transition to regular service. The induction began 30 December 2022 with 22-week training at Belagavi.

questions.subject: Defence GK
questions.q: The Army's Agniveer Recruitment Rally at Agartala in October 2026 reported what change in candidate registrations compared to previous cycles?
questions.e: The five-day Agniveer Recruitment Rally 2026 at Agartala's Dasarath Deb State Sports Complex (13-17 October 2026) saw a 92% rise in registrations; the first 1.6-km run batch on 13 October had 337 candidates.

questions.subject: Defence GK
questions.q: Exiting Agniveers receive a tax-free Seva Nidhi package of approximately:
questions.e: Under the Seva Nidhi package, exiting Agniveers receive about Rs. 11.71 lakh tax-free along with a skill-set certificate. The largest batch of Agniveers is due for Army discharge in December 2026-January 2027.

questions.subject: Defence GK
questions.q: For rehabilitation of Agniveers, the government has reserved what share of constable posts in the Central Armed Police Forces for them?
questions.e: The government has reserved 50% of constable posts in the CAPFs for Agniveers, with a similar reservation announced for riflemen in the Assam Rifles; several states have also announced recruitment policies.

questions.subject: Defence GK
questions.q: The Agnipath scheme, under which the first batch of Agniveers completes its four-year tenure in late 2026, was launched in:
questions.e: The Union Cabinet launched the Agnipath scheme in June 2022, recruiting Agniveers on a four-year contractual basis, with up to 25% eligible for absorption into regular service.

questions.subject: Defence Exams
questions.q: UPSC declared the NDA & NA (II) 2026 written result on 9 October 2026. Approximately how many candidates qualified for the SSB interview?
questions.e: The qualified list carries about 7,886 roll numbers (7,406 male and 480 female) for the 158th NDA Course and 120th Indian Naval Academy Course, commencing 1 July 2027.

questions.subject: GAT (GK)
questions.q: How many candidates qualified in the written examination of NDA & NA (II), 2026 for the SSB interview?
questions.e: UPSC's press note dated 9 October 2026 listed 7,886 roll numbers (7,406 male, 480 female) as having qualified the NDA & NA (II), 2026 written exam for the SSB interview, for the 158th NDA and 120th INA courses commencing 1 July 2027.

questions.subject: GAT (GK)
questions.q: When was the NDA & NA (II), 2026 written examination held?
questions.e: The NDA & NA (II), 2026 written examination was held on 13 September 2026; the result was declared on 9 October 2026.

questions.subject: GAT (English) + SSB
questions.q: What is the correct order of stages in the five-day SSB (Services Selection Board) procedure?
o: Screening → Psychology → GTO tasks → Personal Interview → Conference
questions.e: The five-day SSB procedure runs: Day 1 Screening (OIR + PP&DT), Day 2 Psychology tests, Days 3–4 Group Testing Officer (GTO) tasks, Personal Interview, and Day 5 Conference.

questions.subject: GAT (GK)
questions.q: The Pralay missile, for which DRDO conducted twin user-evaluation trials from Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Island, is best described as a:
questions.e: Pralay is a solid-propellant, quasi-ballistic missile meant for precision strikes, with a range of about 500 km, developed mainly by Research Centre Imarat.

questions.subject: GAT (GK)
questions.q: The Agni-Prime (Agni-P) missile, test-fired from a rail-based mobile launcher in October 2026, has an operational range of up to:
questions.e: Agni-Prime is a canisterised, solid-fuelled, two-stage medium-range ballistic missile with a range of up to 2,000 km.

questions.subject: GAT (Science)
questions.q: DRDO's ULPGM-V3, test-fired at Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh, is a drone-launched precision missile with what daytime range?
questions.e: ULPGM-V3 (UAV-Launched Precision Guided Missile) has a maximum range of 4 km by day and 2.5 km by night; it weighs 12.5 kg and uses an imaging-infrared seeker.

questions.subject: GAT (GK)
questions.q: DRDO's new missile testing range at Junput, which saw its first notified test window of 6–9 October 2026, is located in:
questions.e: The Junput range is in Purba Medinipur district, West Bengal, built as an extension of the Chandipur Integrated Test Range (Odisha), about 70–74 km away.

questions.subject: GAT (GK)
questions.q: In India's layered air-defence architecture, VSHORADS fills which role?
o: Very-short-range protection of frontline units against close-in threats
questions.e: VSHORADS (Very Short Range Air Defence System) shields frontline units and installations against close-in, low-flying threats — the short end below QRSAM, Akash and S-400.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.q: What is the maximum share of each Agniveer batch that can be retained in the regular cadre under current policy?
questions.e: Under current policy, up to 25% of each Agniveer batch can be retained in the regular cadre on merit and need; the government says there is no move to alter this ratio.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.q: Which statement correctly describes the Seva Nidhi package for exiting Agniveers?
o: A tax-free corpus of about Rs 11.71 lakh, with no pension or gratuity
A monthly pension of Rs 11,710 for life
A gratuity of Rs 11.71 lakh plus full pension
A one-time payment of Rs 1.17 lakh
questions.e: Exiting Agniveers receive a tax-free Seva Nidhi corpus of about Rs 11.71 lakh (government-matched contributions) but no pension or gratuity.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.q: How many CEE-shortlisted aspirants participated in the Tripura Agniveer Recruitment Rally held 13-17 October 2026?
questions.e: The five-day rally at Agartala's Dasarath Deb State Sports Complex saw a record 1,203 shortlisted aspirants participate.

questions.subject: Current Affairs
questions.q: The Agnipath scheme, under which the first batch completes its four-year tenure in October 2026, was launched in:
questions.e: Agnipath was launched in June 2022, recruiting men and women aged 17.5-21 for four years including six months of training.

questions.subject: Defence GK
questions.q: GSAT-7B, to be launched by ISRO by mid-2028, will be the first dedicated communication satellite of which service?
questions.e: GSAT-7B is the Indian Army's first dedicated communication satellite (Rs 2,963-crore NSIL deal, 2023). The Army currently depends on the IAF's GSAT-7A; the IAF's own GSAT-7C got a Rs 2,563-crore NSIL contract in October 2026.

questions.subject: Defence GK
questions.q: INS Samarthak, the Indian Navy's first indigenous multi-purpose vessel, was built by:
questions.e: INS Samarthak was constructed by Larsen & Toubro at its Kattupalli shipyard (Tamil Nadu) with over 75% indigenous content, and commissioned at Karwar in October 2026.

questions.subject: Defence GK
questions.q: What is the indigenous content of INS Samarthak, as per official information?
questions.e: Official information puts INS Samarthak's indigenous content at more than 75%. It serves as a trials platform for weapons, sensors and unmanned systems, plus surveillance, patrolling and humanitarian roles.

questions.subject: GAT (GK)
questions.q: On 17 October 2026, ISRO successfully completed ground tests for which Gaganyaan system?
o: Separation of the Crew Module and Service Module
questions.e: ISRO completed ground tests for separation of the Gaganyaan Crew Module and Service Module on 17 October 2026, ahead of the uncrewed G1 flight (carrying the Vyommitra half-humanoid) expected in late 2026.

questions.subject: GAT (GK)
questions.q: The uncrewed Gaganyaan-1 flight, expected in late 2026, will carry which payload in place of astronauts?
o: A full crew module with animals
questions.e: Gaganyaan-1 will carry Vyommitra, a half-humanoid robot, in place of astronauts. The first crewed mission is targeted for 2027.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: INS Sahyadri, which reached Vladivostok on 10 October 2026 for Exercise INDRA 2026, belongs to which class of warships?
questions.e: INS Sahyadri is an indigenously built Shivalik-class guided-missile stealth frigate of the Indian Navy.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: The JWALA system, whose rocket motors were tested in October 2026, is being developed primarily as:
questions.e: JWALA is a micro-missile with a pre-fragmented high-explosive warhead and proximity fuze, designed to destroy cheap enemy drones mid-air - avoiding the waste of expensive conventional air-defence missiles on inexpensive targets.

questions.subject: Defence Technology
questions.q: Where did the DRDO test its Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) platform on a live military network in October 2026?
questions.e: On 14 October 2026 the DRDO successfully configured and tested its QKD platform on the live network of the dynamic test ranges at PXE, Chandipur — protecting real-time critical observations and telemetry of artillery and armoured weapon tests.

questions.subject: Defence Procurement
questions.q: What is the value of the GSAT-7C communication satellite contract signed by the MoD on 15 October 2026?
questions.e: The MoD signed contracts worth ~Rs 4,106 crore on 15 Oct 2026: the GSAT-7C communication satellite for the IAF (Rs 2,563 crore) with NSIL, Bengaluru, and Varunastra torpedoes for the Navy (Rs 1,543 crore) with BDL, Hyderabad.

questions.subject: Defence Technology
questions.q: What maximum altitude did the DRDO's indigenous HAPS attain during its October 2026 flight trial?
questions.e: The indigenous HAPS flight-tested on 6 October 2026 attained 21 km AMSL and held 20 km for over 30 minutes; it is being developed by ADRDE, Agra, a DRDO laboratory.

questions.subject: Defence Policy
questions.q: The proposed National Military Drone Technology Hub, whose approval is nearing completion, is coming up at:
questions.e: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh said on 14 October 2026 that the approval process for the National Military Drone Technology Hub at IIT Kanpur (with the Ministry of Defence) is nearing completion.

questions.subject: Military Exercises
questions.q: Exercise MOUNTAIN GUARDIAN 2026 is being conducted jointly by India and which country?
questions.e: Exercise MOUNTAIN GUARDIAN 2026 is a joint India-UAE exercise at Chaubatia, Uttarakhand with 92 personnel participating.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: Tarang Shakti 2026 was held at Jodhpur Air Force Station. How many observer nations attended it?
questions.e: Tarang Shakti 2026 at Jodhpur had 32 observer nations; Defence Minister Rajnath Singh called for self-reliance in indigenous platforms like Tejas and Akash.

questions.subject: Defence Exams
questions.q: DGQA Recruitment 2026 invites offline applications for how many Technician posts?
questions.e: The Directorate General of Quality Assurance (DGQA) invited offline applications for 32 Technician posts, last date 6 December 2026.

questions.subject: Defence Exams
questions.q: Indian Army TES 57 recruitment 2026 notification is out. What is the last date to apply online?
questions.e: Indian Army Technical Entry Scheme (TES) 57 notification is out with applications open till 12 November 2026; TGC 145 (30 posts) closes on 29 October 2026.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: Which command — India's only tri-services command — is conducting the 20–22 Oct 2026 aerial firing exercise?
questions.e: The Andaman and Nicobar Command (ANC), headquartered at Sri Vijaya Puram, is India's only tri-services command — it integrates the Indian Navy, Army, Air Force and Coast Guard. It issued the NOTMAR for the 20–22 Oct 2026 aerial firing exercise.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: What safety notice did the ANC issue for the Andaman firing exercise (20–22 Oct 2026)?
questions.e: The ANC issued a NOTMAR (Notice to Mariners and Airmen) asking vessels and aircraft to stay clear of the designated area near Sri Vijaya Puram between 10 am and 12:30 pm from 20 to 22 October 2026.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: Which missile systems are typically tested in the Andaman & Nicobar Command's firing drills?
o: BrahMos and Crystal Maze 2, with Su-30MKIs
questions.e: Such ANC drills routinely involve Su-30MKIs (firing cannons), BrahMos and Crystal Maze 2 missile tests, plus Navy MiG-29Ks with airborne early warning support. Su-30MKIs operate from Air Force Station Car Nicobar and INS Utkrosh on rotation.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: Where did Defence Minister Rajnath Singh call for dismantling the “entire ecosystem of terrorism” (Oct 2026)?
o: 25th SCO Council of Heads of Government, Dushanbe
questions.e: At the 25th SCO Council of Heads of Government meeting in Dushanbe, Tajikistan (Oct 2026), Defence Minister Rajnath Singh called for dismantling the “entire ecosystem of terrorism.”

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: China's October 2026 export controls on tunnel-boring machines apply above what altitude?
questions.e: China's new export controls cover tunnel-boring machines for use at altitudes above 3,000 metres — heavy equipment for mountain construction, directly relevant to border infrastructure in the Himalayas (reported 21 Oct 2026).

questions.q: UPSC declared the CDS II 2026 written result on 19 October 2026. How many candidates qualified for the SSB interviews?

questions.q: SIMBEX is the bilateral naval exercise between India and which country?
questions.e: SIMBEX, India's longest-running bilateral naval exercise with a foreign country, is conducted with Singapore.

questions.q: SIMBEX began in 1994 under which original name?
questions.e: SIMBEX began in 1994 as Exercise Lion King and has run every year since without a break, even during the Covid-19 pandemic.

questions.subject: Defence

questions.q: INS Sahyadri, which arrived at Vladivostok for Exercise INDRA 2026, is which class of ship?
questions.e: INS Sahyadri is an indigenously built Shivalik-class guided-missile stealth frigate.

questions.e: DRDO conducted the maiden flight test of the Kusha M1 long-range surface-to-air missile on 23 July 2026 from APJ Abdul Kalam Island; M2 trials (250 km range) are expected by November/December 2026.

questions.e: Very short-range — shielding frontline units from drones, loitering munitions and helicopters, complementing S-400, Akash and QRSAM.

capsules.subject: General
capsules.title: SAREX-2026: India's largest maritime rescue drill (7–8 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The Indian Coast Guard staged the 12th National Maritime Search & Rescue Exercise off Paradip, Odisha, on 7–8 October 2026, inaugurated by Raksha Rajya Mantri Sanjay Seth. Fifteen ICG ships, Dornier aircraft, ALH and Chetak helicopters, IAF C-130J and Mi-17 aircraft and two Navy ships simulated a concurrent aeronautical-maritime emergency: a 228-person aircraft ditching striking the container vessel MV Zumba. Thirty-two observers from 30 countries attended, and the 24th National Maritime SAR Board meeting followed in Bhubaneswar.

capsules.subject: Exercises
capsules.title: Tarang Shakti 2026 concludes at Jodhpur; F-35’s first Indian flight (13 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The Indian Air Force’s flagship multilateral exercise Tarang Shakti 2026 — its second edition — concluded on 13 October 2026 at Jodhpur Airbase, Rajasthan, with eight nations including India. Around 150 domestic and foreign fighter aircraft flew 600+ sorties across ~800 hours of complex aerial operations. The headline moment: the US fifth-generation F-35 Lightning II flew in Indian airspace for the first time. Other assets: US KC-135 aerial refuelling tanker, UAE F-16s, French Rafales and A330 MRTT, C-130Js from Bangladesh and Australia, and Germany’s A400M Atlas. Chief Air Chief Marshal Amarpreet Singh flew a Tejas on his final fighter-pilot sortie ahead of his 31 October retirement; Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit takes over as Air Chief on 1 November. The next edition is scheduled in two years.

capsules.subject: Exercises
capsules.title: India–UAE Mountain Guardian 2026 underway at Chaubatia (5–18 Oct)
capsules.body: The 3rd edition of the India–UAE joint military exercise Mountain Guardian 2026 is underway from 5 to 18 October 2026 at the Foreign Training Node, Chaubatia, Uttarakhand. 92 personnel (equal representation) are participating — the Indian contingent from a Bhairav Battalion and the UAE contingent from a Mountain Infantry Battalion. Troops are conducting joint tactical drills, operational planning, surveillance-grid establishment, drone operations and integrated field exercises focused on sub-conventional operations in mountainous terrain, using modern technology to boost interoperability. The exercise strengthens the growing India–UAE defence partnership.

capsules.subject: Defence
capsules.title: India-Czech defence industrial cooperation (13 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: On 13 October 2026, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and Czech First Deputy PM Karel Havlicek agreed in New Delhi to deepen defence industrial cooperation through joint ventures and the India-Czech Joint Defence Committee, backing Make in India and Aatmanirbhar Bharat. Both sides also discussed regional peace and security.

capsules.subject: DRDO
capsules.title: DRDO: stratospheric airship test and ESTIC-2026 semiconductors session
capsules.body: The DRDO flight-tested a stratospheric airship in October 2026. It will also lead the 'Semiconductors and Next-Gen Chips' session at ESTIC-2026 (27-29 October), with keynotes from Micron India, Bharat Semi, Netrasemi and IIT Madras, plus a panel moderated by DG (ECS) B. K. Das with Qualcomm, Tata Semiconductor, BEL and BITS Pilani — aligned to India's 2030/2035/2047 semiconductor goals.

capsules.subject: Missiles
capsules.title: DRDO test-fires drone-launched ULPGM-V3 missile in Andhra Pradesh
capsules.body: DRDO successfully test-fired the ULPGM-V3 (UAV-Launched Precision Guided Missile, also called ULM-ER) at Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh, in the National Open Area Range. It is a fire-and-forget, air-to-surface missile weighing 12.5 kg with dual-thrust solid propulsion, a range of 4 km by day and 2.5 km by night, passive homing via an imaging infrared seeker, a two-way datalink, and multiple warhead options for static and moving targets.

capsules.subject: Missiles
capsules.title: DRDO and IAF flight-test indigenous Astra missile from Su-30 Mk-I
capsules.body: DRDO and the Indian Air Force successfully flight-tested the indigenous Astra Beyond Visual Range Air-to-Air Missile (BVRAAM) from a Sukhoi-30 Mk-I over Odisha. Two launches against high-speed unmanned aerial targets at different ranges destroyed both targets with pin-point accuracy, validating all subsystems including the indigenous seeker. Astra has a range of over 100 km and is already in IAF service.

capsules.subject: Missiles
capsules.title: Astra roadmap: Mk-2 beyond 200 km, Project Gandiva beyond 300 km
capsules.body: DRDO is extending the Astra family: Astra Mk-1 (~100 km) is in IAF service and has been tested from Su-30 MKI and Tejas; Astra Mk-2 trials are under way with range over 200 km; and Project Gandiva (Astra Mk-3), the longest-range variant, is being developed for ranges beyond 300 km.

capsules.subject: Air Defence
capsules.title: VL-SRSAM programme moves towards User Evaluation Trials
capsules.body: DRDO’s Vertical Launch Short Range Surface-to-Air Missile (VL-SRSAM) programme for the Indian Navy has completed developmental trials of its Multi-Function Radar and is progressing towards User Evaluation Trials — a step towards an indigenous naval air-defence shield against low-flying missiles, aircraft and drones, including sea-skimming threats.

capsules.subject: Current Affairs
capsules.title: NDA II 2026: SSB registration within two weeks of result
capsules.body: Candidates who qualified the NDA & NA (II) 2026 written exam (result 9 Oct 2026) must complete SSB interview registration formalities within two weeks of the result announcement - around 23 October 2026 - via joinindianarmy.nic.in. About 7,886 candidates were shortlisted for 394 vacancies; qualifiers will join the 158th NDA Course / 120th INAC commencing 1 July 2027.

capsules.subject: Current Affairs
capsules.title: Rajnath Singh at ASEAN-India Defence Think Tank Forum
capsules.body: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh delivered the inaugural address at the ASEAN-India Defence Think Tank Forum (Oct 2026), underlining India's defence engagement with Southeast Asia (15 Oct 2026).

capsules.subject: Current Affairs
capsules.title: Air India Frankfurt-Delhi flight diverted to Jaipur
capsules.body: Air India flight AI2030 operating from Frankfurt to Delhi was diverted to Jaipur following a security alert over a suspected hijack threat (Oct 2026).

capsules.subject: GAT (GK)
capsules.title: Amit Shah calls for stronger BIMSTEC unity against terrorism (15 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: Home Minister Amit Shah called on 15 October 2026 for stronger BIMSTEC unity against terrorism, urging member nations to work together to cut off terror funding and drug smuggling networks in the region — a key regional-security development for defence current affairs.

capsules.subject: GAT (GK)
capsules.title: Iran-backed Houthis strike Aramco HQ (15 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: Iran-backed Houthi rebels hit the headquarters of the Saudi state-owned oil company Aramco in an overnight strike, two regional officials said on 15 October 2026, damaging the offices of the firm's chief executive and other top officials — an important West Asia security development with implications for India's energy security.

capsules.subject: GAT (GK)
capsules.title: DGQA Technician recruitment 2026: 32 posts — apply 17 Oct to 6 Nov
capsules.body: The Directorate General of Quality Assurance (DGQA) invited applications for 32 Technician posts (11 Skilled, 21 Semi-Skilled) under Advt No. CQA(GS)/2026/1. Candidates aged 18–27 can apply offline from 17 October to 6 November 2026 (5:00 PM; 13 November for remote areas); there is no application fee. Skilled technicians need Class 10 + ITI in the related field with one year's experience; pay is Level-2 (₹19,900–63,200) for Skilled and Level-1 (₹18,000–56,900) for Semi-Skilled.

capsules.subject: Defence
capsules.title: Cabinet Secretariat DFO (Technical): 250 Group B posts via GATE — offline apply 17 Oct–15 Nov (16 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: Advt No. 02/2026: 250 Deputy Field Officer (Technical) posts — CS/IT 112, Electronics/Communication 112, Data Science/AI 10, Physics 5, Mechanical 4, Civil 3, Chemistry 2, Mathematics 1, Statistics 1. B.E./B.Tech or M.Sc with valid GATE 2024/2025/2026; age up to 30; Level-7 pay (~₹1 lakh/month initial emoluments). Apply offline 17 October–15 November 2026; official site cabsec.gov.in. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

capsules.subject: Defence
capsules.title: Indian Army TES-57: 90 posts — course from July 2027; last date 12 Nov 2026 (16 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The Indian Army's 10+2 Technical Entry Scheme (TES-57) notified 90 provisional vacancies for unmarried candidates for a Permanent Commission course commencing July 2027. The application deadline is 12 November 2026. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

capsules.subject: Defence GK
capsules.title: IAF retains 712 first-batch Agniveer Vayus
capsules.body: The Indian Air Force completed retention of 712 personnel from its first batch of 2,850 Agniveer Vayu recruits (about 25%) for absorption into the regular cadre in October 2026. Induction began 30 December 2022; 2,675 of the original batch completed the 22-week training at the Airmen Training School, Belagavi.

capsules.subject: Defence GK
capsules.title: First-batch Agniveer discharge timeline
capsules.body: The first batch of Agniveers under the Agnipath scheme (launched June 2022, four-year tenure) is due for discharge: the Navy batch in November 2026, the Air Force batch in October-November 2026, and the largest Army batch in December 2026-January 2027. Exiting Agniveers get a tax-free Seva Nidhi package of about Rs. 11.71 lakh plus a skill certificate; 50% of CAPF constable posts are reserved for them.

capsules.subject: Defence Exams
capsules.title: NDA & NA (II) 2026: written result declared, SSB next — Verified: 17 Oct 2026
capsules.body: UPSC declared the written result of the NDA & NA Examination (II) 2026 (held 13 September) on 9 October 2026. The 394 vacancies cover the Army, Navy and Air Force wings of the 158th NDA Course and the 120th Indian Naval Academy Course, both commencing 1 July 2027. Qualified candidates must register on joinindianarmy.nic.in within two weeks (by about 23 October) for SSB centre allocation.

capsules.subject: GAT (GK)
capsules.title: NDA (II) 2026 written result: 7,886 qualify for SSB
capsules.body: The Union Public Service Commission declared the written result of the NDA & NA Examination (II), 2026 in a press note dated 9 October 2026 (exam held 13 September 2026). 7,886 roll numbers (7,406 male, 480 female) qualified for the Services Selection Board interview, provisionally, for the 158th NDA Course and 120th Indian Naval Academy Course commencing 1 July 2027. Qualified candidates must register on joinindianarmy.nic.in within two weeks of the result (by about 23 October 2026). The written exam totals 900 marks; final merit adds SSB marks (total 1,800).

capsules.subject: GAT (GK)
capsules.title: Agniveer rally in Jalandhar 14–22 Nov 2026
capsules.body: An Agniveer Recruitment Rally will be held at the Government Arts and Sports College, Jalandhar, from 14 to 22 November 2026. Over 6,000 candidates who qualified in the Common Entrance Examination (CEE) are expected from Tarn Taran, Kapurthala, Jalandhar, Hoshiarpur and SBS Nagar districts. Women candidates from Punjab, J&K and Ladakh are also included. Tests: 1.6-km run, beam test, physical measurements and medical examination; candidates have been warned against touts.

capsules.subject: GAT (GK)
capsules.title: Agartala Agniveer rally (13–17 Oct): registrations up 92%
capsules.body: The Indian Army's five-day Agniveer Recruitment Rally 2026 at the Dasarath Deb State Sports Complex, Agartala (under Spear Corps and ARO Silchar) ran 13–17 October 2026, with 337 candidates in the opening 1.6-km run batch. Army officials reported candidate registrations 92% higher than previous cycles. Stages: 1.6-km run, physical fitness and measurement tests, document verification and medical examinations.

capsules.subject: GAT (GK)
capsules.title: Agni-Prime fired from rail-based launcher — a first
capsules.body: In October 2026, India successfully test-fired Agni-Prime from a specially designed rail-based mobile launcher — the first time this missile has been launched from a rail platform. Agni-P is a next-generation, canisterised, solid-fuelled, two-stage medium-range ballistic missile with an operational range of up to 2,000 km, adding a new dimension to India's strategic deterrence.

capsules.subject: GAT (GK)
capsules.title: VSHORADS flight trials succeed (October 2026)
capsules.body: DRDO's successful flight trials of the Very Short Range Air Defence System (VSHORADS) in October 2026 validated the system in its final deployment configuration. Designed for the Army, Navy and Air Force, VSHORADS shields frontline units against low-flying threats — drones, helicopters and loitering munitions — completing the short end of India's layered air defence (S-400 → Akash → QRSAM → VSHORADS) under Atmanirbhar Bharat.

capsules.subject: GAT (GK)
capsules.title: Pralay twin trials: quasi-ballistic, 500 km
capsules.body: DRDO conducted two consecutive user-evaluation flight tests of the Pralay missile from Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Island, Odisha, validating maximum and minimum range with both missiles hitting targets accurately. Pralay is a solid-propellant, quasi-ballistic missile for precision strikes (about 500 km), developed mainly by Research Centre Imarat (RCI) with DRDL and ASL, plus industry partners BDL, BEL and MSMEs.

capsules.subject: GAT (Science)
capsules.title: ULPGM-V3: drone-launched precision missile tested at Kurnool
capsules.body: DRDO successfully test-fired the ULPGM-V3 (UAV-Launched Precision Guided Missile) at Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh. The 12.5 kg fire-and-forget, air-to-surface missile uses dual-thrust solid propulsion, an imaging-infrared seeker and a two-way datalink, with a range of 4 km by day and 2.5 km by night and multiple warhead options.

capsules.subject: GAT (GK)
capsules.title: Junput: new DRDO test range's first notified window
capsules.body: A NOTAM for 6–9 October 2026 marked the first disclosed missile-test window at DRDO's new Junput range, Purba Medinipur (West Bengal). Developed as an extension of the Chandipur ITR (Odisha) — roughly 70–74 km away — the facility adds testing capacity on the east coast for trials needing a larger engagement envelope.

capsules.subject: GAT (Science)
capsules.title: ADRDE's stratospheric platform reaches 21 km
capsules.body: DRDO's Aerial Delivery Research and Development Establishment (ADRDE), Agra flew a lighter-than-air stratospheric platform to 21 km above mean sea level in October 2026, relaying real-time video and vehicle parameters to ground control — a step toward long-endurance high-altitude pseudo-satellite missions.

capsules.subject: Current Affairs
capsules.title: First Agniveer batch completes tenure; services seek scheme improvements (Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The first batch of Agniveers, enrolled in 2023, completes its four-year tenure in October 2026. Drawing on four years of implementation experience, the Army, Navy and Air Force have sent a consolidated report with improvement recommendations to the Department of Military Affairs, though its contents were not disclosed. The government maintains there is no move to alter the 25% retention ratio. Agnipath (launched June 2022) inducts men and women aged 17.5-21 for four years including six months of training; those exiting receive a tax-free Seva Nidhi package of about Rs 11.71 lakh but no pension or gratuity.

capsules.subject: Current Affairs
capsules.title: Record Tripura Agniveer rally concludes; Jalandhar rally next (Oct-Nov 2026)
capsules.body: The Indian Army concluded its five-day Agniveer Recruitment Rally 2026 at the Dasarath Deb State Sports Complex in Agartala on 17 October 2026, organised by ARO Silchar under HQ Recruiting Zone (North East States), Shillong. A record 1,203 shortlisted aspirants took part after the Common Entrance Examination, with the Army expecting more than double last year's selection rate from Tripura. Next, a rally at Government Arts and Sports College, Jalandhar, from 14 to 22 November 2026 will assess over 6,000 CEE-qualified candidates from Tarn Taran, Kapurthala, Jalandhar, Hoshiarpur and SBS Nagar districts, plus women candidates from Punjab, J&K and Ladakh, through the 1.6-km run, beam test and medical examination.

capsules.subject: Current Affairs
capsules.title: Rs 4,106 crore defence contracts; Rs 1.5 lakh crore awaiting CCS nod (Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The Ministry of Defence signed contracts worth Rs 4,106 crore for the GSAT-7C satellite and Varunastra torpedoes, reported 18 October 2026. Separately, four major defence programmes worth Rs 1.5 lakh crore are awaiting Cabinet Committee on Security clearance, with timely order awards flagged as key for the defence capital-expenditure pipeline. India and the US also announced a ten-year defence framework in October 2026.

capsules.subject: Defence
capsules.title: GSAT-7B: the Army gets its own satellite
capsules.body: The Indian Army is set to receive its first dedicated communication satellite, GSAT-7B, with ISRO expected to launch it by mid-2028 after a six-month technical delay. The geostationary satellite will provide round-the-clock secure connectivity and mission-critical beyond-line-of-sight communication for troops in remote border areas, strengthening battlefield command and control. It follows a Rs 2,963-crore deal the Defence Ministry signed with NewSpace India Limited (NSIL) in 2023. The Army currently depends on the IAF's GSAT-7A. Separately, in October 2026 the Defence Ministry signed a Rs 2,563-crore contract with NSIL for the indigenously designed GSAT-7C satellite for the Indian Air Force.

capsules.subject: Defence
capsules.title: INS Samarthak: a trial ship for the Navy's future
capsules.body: INS Samarthak, commissioned at Karwar in October 2026, is the Indian Navy's first indigenous multi-purpose vessel, built by Larsen & Toubro at its Kattupalli shipyard in Tamil Nadu with more than 75% indigenous content. Unlike a single-role warship, it is designed as a trials and evaluation platform: the Navy will use it to test weapons, sensors and unmanned/autonomous systems before wider adoption. Its other planned roles include maritime surveillance and reconnaissance, offshore patrolling and humanitarian assistance during emergencies.

capsules.subject: Defence
capsules.title: Exercise INDRA 2026: India-Russia naval exercise at Vladivostok
capsules.body: The annual India-Russia bilateral naval exercise INDRA 2026 was held 13-18 October 2026 at Vladivostok, Russia. INS Sahyadri, an indigenously built Shivalik-class guided-missile stealth frigate, reached Vladivostok on 10 October 2026 for the exercise. The 2025 edition (28 March - 2 April) was held off Chennai and in the Bay of Bengal with INS Rana, INS Kuthar and a P-8I maritime patrol aircraft. INDRA anchors the India-Russia defence partnership - the BrahMos missile, licensed production of the Su-30MKI, T-90S tanks, the AK-203 joint venture and the S-400 air-defence system; on the naval side, INS Tushil and INS Tamal were commissioned in December 2024 and July 2025. - Verified: 20 Oct 2026

capsules.subject: Defence Technology
capsules.title: DRDO tests QKD on live military network at PXE Chandipur (14 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The DRDO announced on 14 October 2026 that it had successfully configured and tested a Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) platform on the live network of the dynamic test ranges at the Proof and Experimental Establishment (PXE), Chandipur. The platform was designed and developed under DRDO's Microelectronic Devices, Computational Systems and Cyber Security (MCC) cluster in collaboration with its production partner, Bengaluru-based Taqbit Labs. The demonstration showed how QKD can fortify real-time critical observations and telemetry associated with artillery and armoured weapon tests and evaluation — providing unconditional security for key distribution together with eavesdropping detection. This marks practical application of indigenous quantum technologies to military communications, safeguarding data generated during weapons testing.

capsules.subject: Defence Procurement
capsules.title: MoD signs Rs 4,106 crore contracts: GSAT-7C for IAF, Varunastra torpedoes for Navy (15 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: On 15 October 2026, the Ministry of Defence signed contracts worth approximately Rs 4,106 crore in New Delhi (in the presence of Additional Secretary and DG (Acquisition) A. Anbarasu): the GSAT-7C communication satellite for the Indian Air Force, valued at Rs 2,563 crore, contracted with NewSpace India Limited (NSIL), Bengaluru; and Varunastra heavyweight torpedoes for the Indian Navy, valued at Rs 1,543 crore, contracted with Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL), Hyderabad — strengthening military communications and underwater warfare capabilities.

capsules.subject: Defence Technology
capsules.title: DRDO flight-tests indigenous HAPS airship to 21 km altitude (6 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The DRDO successfully conducted the flight trial of its indigenously developed High-Altitude Platform System (HAPS) on 6 October 2026: the lighter-than-air system attained an altitude of 21 km above mean sea level and remained at 20 km AMSL for more than 30 minutes before being commanded to descend and was successfully recovered. HAPS is being designed and developed by the Aerial Delivery Research and Development Establishment (ADRDE), Agra — a DRDO laboratory — as a long-endurance stratospheric aerial surveillance platform for intelligence gathering and earth observation missions.

capsules.subject: Defence Policy
capsules.title: National Military Drone Technology Hub at IIT Kanpur — approval nearing completion (14 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh said on 14 October 2026 (at the launch of IIT Kanpur's 'Greater Than Us' fundraising campaign in New Delhi) that the proposal to establish a National Military Drone Technology Hub at IIT Kanpur, in collaboration with the Ministry of Defence, has made significant progress with the approval process nearing completion. The hub aims to fast-track indigenisation and innovation to give India a combat edge, as AI, autonomous systems, unmanned platforms, advanced sensors, cybersecurity and space-based technologies reshape warfare — with close collaboration among the armed forces, DRDO, academic institutions, DPSUs and private industry including start-ups.

capsules.subject: Military Exercises
capsules.title: Exercise MOUNTAIN GUARDIAN 2026: India-UAE at Chaubatia, Uttarakhand (92 personnel)
capsules.body: Exercise MOUNTAIN GUARDIAN 2026 is being conducted jointly by India and the UAE at Chaubatia, Uttarakhand, with 92 personnel participating — a bilateral Army exercise strengthening mountain-warfare interoperability.

capsules.subject: Defence
capsules.title: Tarang Shakti 2026: self-reliance pitch for Tejas and Akash
capsules.body: 21 Oct 2026. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, at the Tarang Shakti 2026 air exercise held at Jodhpur Air Force Station, called for self-reliance in indigenous platforms such as Tejas, Dhruv, Rudra, Prachand and Akash under Atmanirbhar Bharat. The exercise drew 32 observer nations. Exam angle: defence exercises, indigenous platforms, and Atmanirbhar Bharat questions.

capsules.subject: Defence
capsules.title: Tri-services aerial firing exercise in the Andamans (20–22 Oct 2026)
capsules.body:
A three-day strategic aerial firing exercise is underway near Sri Vijaya Puram in the Andaman & Nicobar Islands (20–22 Oct 2026). The Andaman and Nicobar Command (ANC) — India's only tri-services command (Navy, Army, Air Force, Coast Guard) — issued a NOTMAR (Notice to Mariners and Airmen) for 10 am–12:30 pm daily.

Su-30MKIs (operating from Car Nicobar and INS Utkrosh), MiG-29Ks with AEW&C support, cannon fire, missile and rocket launches — such drills routinely test BrahMos and Crystal Maze 2. The islands sit ~1,200 km from the mainland, guarding the Six Degree Channel and Malacca Strait approaches.

capsules.title: Rajnath Singh at 25th SCO Heads of Government meet, Dushanbe (Oct 2026)
capsules.body: At the 25th meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of Government in Dushanbe, Tajikistan (Oct 2026), Defence Minister Rajnath Singh called for dismantling the “entire ecosystem of terrorism” — a strong multilateral counter-terror pitch by India at the SCO forum.

capsules.subject: Defence
capsules.title: China restricts TBM exports for use above 3,000 m (Oct 2026)
capsules.body:
China has imposed export controls on tunnel-boring machines (TBMs) used at altitudes above 3,000 metres — equipment critical for mountain construction, including border infrastructure (reported 21 Oct 2026).

Defence-exam angle: dual-use technology controls as a tool of strategic competition; India's own border-roads push under BRO in Ladakh/Arunachal makes TBM access a live capability question.

capsules.subject: Defence
capsules.title: US visa revocations cross 300,000; legal immigration halved (Oct 2026)
capsules.body:
On 20 Oct 2026 the US State Department said the Trump administration has revoked 300,000+ visas at the fastest pace in US history; separately, US legal immigration fell from ~52,000 to ~26,000 a month as visa curbs hit 150+ countries.

Strategic angle: immigration as an instrument of statecraft — talent-flow restrictions reshaping global mobility, with implications for India's diaspora and remittance economy.

capsules.subject: Exercises
capsules.title: A busy fortnight for India's armed forces
capsules.body: India's armed forces concluded a three-day tri-service drill in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands on 22 October, even as SIMBEX with Singapore got underway off Visakhapatnam and INS Sahyadri reached Vladivostok for INDRA 2026 — a concentrated show of joint and bilateral operational readiness.

capsules.subject: DRDO
capsules.title: Junput and Kusha: missile milestones
capsules.body: DRDO opened its new Junput testing range in West Bengal with a first notified window (6–9 October), while Project Kusha — India's indigenous long-range air-defence programme with M1 (150 km), M2 (250 km) and M3 (350–400 km) interceptors — lines up M2 trials by year-end.

capsules.subject: GAT (GK)
capsules.title: MoD signs Rs 661.50 cr BrahMos contract (6 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The Ministry of Defence signed a Rs 661.50-crore contract with BrahMos Aerospace Pvt Ltd for BrahMos Fire Control System and Launchers for Indian Navy ships under the Buy (Indian-IDDM) category, with a minimum 68% indigenous content and employment generation over three years. BrahMos is the Navy's primary surface-to-surface missile for maritime strike — land and sea targets at supersonic speed with pinpoint accuracy.

capsules.subject: GAT (GK)
capsules.title: DRDO's HAPS flight trial: 21 km altitude, 30+ min at 20 km
capsules.body: DRDO successfully flight-tested an indigenous High-Altitude Platform (HAPS): it reached 21 km above mean sea level and held 20 km for over 30 minutes before a commanded descent and recovery. The platform carried an IMU, GPS receiver, onboard cameras and altitude-control systems. Trial agencies: IAF, CEMILAC, DGCA, AAI. HAPS are 'pseudo-satellites' for surveillance and communications — a high-yield NDA/CDS concept.

capsules.subject: GAT (GK)
capsules.title: Project Kusha: M2 interceptor (250 km) trial expected Nov/Dec 2026
capsules.body: DRDO is preparing the first developmental trials of the Kusha M2 interceptor (250 km range) by November/December 2026. Project Kusha is India's indigenous extended-range air-defence programme (the S-400-class answer), bridging MRSAM (70-80 km) and S-400 (400 km): M1 (150 km) was tested on 23 July 2026; M3 (350-400 km) follows. A naval Kusha variant (200-300 km) is planned for next-generation destroyers.

capsules.subject: GAT (GK)
capsules.title: VSHORADS flight trials successful (reported 23 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: DRDO's Very Short-Range Air Defence System (VSHORADS) completed successful flight trials in its final deployment configuration. It fills the lowest layer of India's multi-layered air defence (S-400 long-range, Akash medium, QRSAM short, VSHORADS very-short), shielding frontline units from drones, loitering munitions and helicopters. Tri-service utility: Army, Navy and Air Force — a flagship Atmanirbhar Bharat programme replacing Russian-origin shoulder-fired systems.

capsules.subject: GAT (GK)
capsules.title: GSAT-7R (CMS-03): 4,410 kg — the Navy's new communication satellite (Oct 2026)
capsules.body: GSAT-7R (CMS-03), India's heaviest indigenously built communication satellite at 4,410 kg, upgrades GSAT-7 for the Indian Navy: broader coverage, better bandwidth, enhanced security. It strengthens maritime domain awareness, network-centric operations and the Defence Space Segment's secure, jam-resistant communications — with civil spillovers for disaster response and island connectivity.
